title: Confirm chute closure and destination unavailable when tote reaches full threshold
summary: Verify that when a tote reaches the system’s “full” threshold (~80%), the system closes the chute and communicates to Chat that the chute/destination is unavailable so no additional packages come down during the tote exchange.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when you need to confirm the expected behavior that occurs at the tote “full” threshold: the chute is closed (highest priority) and Chat is told the chute is unavailable so packages do not continue coming down during the exchange.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the diagnostic checks by correlating tote fullness threshold behavior with the chute-closure/unavailable communication described by the source.
access_or_tools_needed: Chat interface/logs where the chute unavailable directive is communicated (as referenced by the source)

visual_references.description: Training segment evidence for: two thresholds (pretty full ~60%, full ~80%); at full the chute is closed; when a tote is full the system tells Chat the chute is unavailable so no packages come down during exchange.

steps.title: Identify the tote fullness state using the source thresholds (~80% full)
steps.purpose: Determine whether the tote is at the “full” threshold where the chute closure and destination unavailability behavior should occur.
steps.instruction: Using the tote fullness thresholds described by the source, confirm the tote is at the “full” threshold (~80%).
steps.expected_result: The tote is at the “full” threshold (~80%), which is the point where the source states the chute is closed (highest priority).
steps.healthy_condition: Tote fullness is at/over the “full” threshold (~80%) rather than only “pretty full” (~60%).
steps.failure_condition: The tote is not at the “full” threshold (~80%) (e.g., it is only in the “pretty full” range ~60%), so chute closure/unavailable behavior should not be expected yet.

actions.label: Confirm tote fullness is at full (~80%)
actions.exact_action: Confirm the tote is at the “full” threshold (~80%)

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Source describes two thresholds: “pretty full” ~60% and “full” ~80%, and states that at 80% “we have closed the chute… That means our time… KPI…”.

steps.title: Check that Chat is told the chute is unavailable so no packages come down during exchange
steps.purpose: Validate the mechanism that prevents additional packages from coming down during the tote exchange when the tote is full.
steps.instruction: When the tote is at the “full” threshold, check Chat communications/logs for the directive that the chute is unavailable so that no packages come down while doing an exchange.
steps.expected_result: At the full threshold (~80%), Chat receives/reflects the message that the chute is unavailable, preventing additional packages from coming down during the exchange.
steps.healthy_condition: Chat indicates the chute is unavailable specifically tied to the tote being full, aligning with the source’s stated behavior.
steps.failure_condition: Chat does not show the chute-unavailable indication while the tote is at the full threshold, meaning the source-described mechanism to stop additional packages during exchange is not present.

actions.label: Verify chute-unavailable directive to Chat at full
actions.exact_action: Check Chat for the chute-unavailable directive when the tote is full

stop_or_escalate_if: If the chute-unavailable indication is not present when the tote is at the full threshold, escalate (source states this should prevent additional packages from coming down during exchange).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Source states: “When a tote is full, we tell Chat that the chute is unavailable so that no packages come down while doing an exchange.”

steps.title: Confirm the chute is closed at the full threshold (highest priority)
steps.purpose: Confirm the physical/operational state that the source describes as the highest-priority behavior at the full threshold.
steps.instruction: At the time the tote reaches the “full” threshold (~80%), confirm the chute is closed.
steps.expected_result: At the full threshold (~80%), the chute is closed.
steps.healthy_condition: Chute closure is observed/confirmed at the full threshold, consistent with the source’s statement that at 80% the chute is closed (highest priority).
steps.failure_condition: The chute is not closed when the tote is at the full threshold (~80%).

actions.label: Confirm chute closure at full (~80%)
actions.exact_action: Confirm the chute is closed at the full threshold (~80%)

stop_or_escalate_if: If the chute is not closed at the full threshold, note this as a failure of the source-described highest-priority behavior and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Source states: “80% we have closed the chute… The chute’s already closed.” and also: “at full threshold the chute is closed.”

steps.title: If chute closure/unavailable behavior is missing at full, record and escalate
steps.purpose: Ensure the diagnostic outcome is captured and escalated when the system does not perform the source-described stop mechanism during exchange.
steps.instruction: If either (a) Chat does not indicate the chute is unavailable at full, or (b) the chute is not closed at full, document the discrepancy and escalate per your support process.
steps.expected_result: A discrepancy is recorded when the source-described behavior is not present at the full threshold, and escalation is initiated.
steps.healthy_condition: No discrepancy: both Chat indicates chute unavailable and the chute is closed at full.
steps.failure_condition: Discrepancy exists: chute not closed and/or Chat does not indicate chute unavailable while tote is at full.

actions.label: Escalate discrepancy
actions.exact_action: Escalate if chute closure/unavailable indication is not present when tote is at the full threshold

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the chute closure/unavailable indication is not present when the tote is at the full threshold.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Source ties full threshold to: “chute is unavailable so that no packages come down while doing an exchange” and “at full threshold the chute is closed.”

success_criteria: When tote fullness reaches the “full” threshold (~80%), the chute is closed.
At the same full threshold, Chat indicates the chute is unavailable so no packages come down during the exchange.
healthy_conditions: Tote is at “full” (~80%) rather than only “pretty full” (~60%).
Chat shows/reflects chute-unavailable messaging during exchange at full.
Chute closure is observed at full.
failure_conditions: Tote is at full (~80%) but Chat does not indicate chute is unavailable.
Tote is at full (~80%) but the chute is not closed.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if chute closure/unavailable indication is not present when the tote is at the full threshold, since the source describes this as the mechanism to stop packages during exchange.

screens_or_images.description: Evidence for thresholds (~60% pretty full, ~80% full), chute closure at 80%, and Chat message: chute unavailable so no packages come down during exchange.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Two thresholds exist: “pretty full” (~60%) and “full” (~80%). At full: “we have closed the chute… The chute’s already closed.” Also: “When a tote is full, we tell Chat that the chute is unavailable so that no packages come down while doing an exchange.”
